posts.title: CodePen Commander — Sync, serve, and build local CodePen 2.0 Pens straight from the CLI
posts.description: I scratched my own itch (again 😅) and built CodePen Commander — a CLI cdpn command to sync local folders with CodePen 2.0 Pens, deploy them, and manage privacy rules right from the terminal.

posts.title: GTA.js, a reimplementation of the 1997 Grand Theft Auto engine in JavaScript and WebGL
posts.description: Here’s a little sideproject I’ve been spending my tokens on: https://gtajs.wtf/ It’s a reimplementation of the 1997 Grand Theft Auto engine in JavaScript and WebGL.

posts.title: Scroll-Triggered Animations Debugger (DevTools Extension)
posts.description: I’m extremely pleased to announce the release of Scroll-Triggered Animations Debugger , a DevTools extension to visualize and debug CSS Scroll-Triggered Animations .
